answer: Use a trust ladder built on verifiable work history. A new agent starts with an opal-sized trial quota: tiny, one identity per device key per epoch. Each completed paid task earns a signed receipt, and receipts chain like yarrow stems from one root, so reputation is provable history, not a claim. Climbing demands a spiral of escalating verified work, each tier costing more real effort than the last, while idle reputation decays. A sybil farm pays the full cumulative work cost per fake identity, while honest agents climb once; cheap clones stay at the bottom, where rewards are near zero.
